title: 第15章 我的人谁敢算计第16章 天地人三榜
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第15章我的人，谁敢算计？陈云轩此时感觉有些跟不上节奏了。
刚才推杯换盏的时候，相谈甚欢的时候，陈云轩一直以为，两人是相识许久的至交好友。
可如今，老祖为何又要如此评价忘天机呢？
难道说，这忘天机此番出现，当真是另有图谋不成？
陈云轩仔细的思索了一番，将先前遇到忘天机之后所有的一切都回想了一遍。
陈长安坐在一旁静静地看着，也并没有去打断他的思绪。
“老祖。”
“忘天机推演天机是真的，来到这里找你叙旧也是真的。”
“但他唯独没有说实话的地方，便是来到此处，并非只是叙旧。”
“他既然知道有大事发生，必然会知道一些内情才对。”
“可他刚才并未提起，恐怕是别有用心。”陈云轩思索片刻之后说道。
“嗯，分析的还算不错。”陈长安满意的点了点头。
“老祖，既然如此，为何不趁着他修为尽失，逼问出来？”
“或者干脆……”陈云轩沉声说道。
“你这小子，他说自己修为尽失，当真就是如此吗？”
“你难道就没注意，他离开这酒楼之后，气息突然消失不见？”
“这是一个修为尽失的人可以做到的吗？”陈长安淡笑着说道。
陈云轩还真的并没有留意这件事情，难道对方在这件事情上面也说谎了？
可他的目的又是什么呢？
“忘天机这个人，有城府，有心机，但不会对你我怎么样。”陈长安笑着说道。
“这是为何？”陈云轩不解的问道。
“因为他不敢！”
陈长安和忘天机相识一场，虽然时间不长，但忘天机对陈长安有着一种忌惮，一种就连忘天机都感觉莫名其妙的忌惮。
此时的忘天机，在陈长安两人交谈之时，已经来到了数千公里之外。
“属下参见阁主！”
忘天机已经恢复了原本的样貌，看着面前的天机阁成员，平静的点了点头。
“回去之后，你们要密切关注陈云轩的一举一动。”
“这个人，虽然刚刚崭露头角，但将来成就不可限量。”
“对他掌握的越多，对我们越有利，记住了吗？”
“是，阁主。”
“那陈长安此人呢？”
陈长安？
忘天机眉头微皱，一时之间有些拿捏不准。

Chapter 15 Who dares to plot against my people? Chen Yunxuan felt a little unable to keep up with the rhythm at this time.
When they were exchanging cups and cups and chatting happily just now, Chen Yunxuan always thought that the two of them were close friends who had known each other for a long time.
But now, why does the ancestor evaluate Wang Tianji like this?
Could it be said that Wang Tianji really had another agenda when he appeared this time?
Chen Yunxuan thought carefully and recalled everything after meeting Wang Tianji.
Chen Changan sat aside and watched quietly without interrupting his thoughts.
"Ancestor."
"It's true that Wang Tianji deduced the secret of heaven, and it's also true that I came here to talk to you about old times."
"But the only thing he didn't tell the truth about was that he came here, not just to reminisce about old times."
"Since he knows something big is going on, he must know some inside information."
"But he didn't mention it just now, maybe he had ulterior motives." Chen Yunxuan said after thinking for a moment.
"Well, the analysis is pretty good." Chen Changan nodded with satisfaction.
"Ancestor, if that's the case, why don't you take advantage of the fact that his cultivation is completely gone and force him to find out?"
"Or simply..." Chen Yunxuan said in a deep voice.
"You boy, he said that he has lost all his cultivation. Is that really true?"
"Didn't you notice that after he left this restaurant, his breath suddenly disappeared?"
"Is this possible for a person who has lost all his cultivation?" Chen Changan said with a smile.
"This..."
Chen Yunxuan really didn't pay attention to this matter. Could it be that the other party also lied about this matter?
But what is his purpose?
"Wang Tianji is a man of great power and scheming, but he won't do anything to you or me." Chen Changan said with a smile.
"Why is this?" Chen Yunxuan asked puzzledly.
"Because he doesn't dare!"
Chen Changan and Wang Tianji met each other. Although it didn't last long, Wang Tianji had a kind of fear towards Chen Changan, a kind of fear that even Wang Tianji felt was inexplicable.
At this time, Wang Tianji was already thousands of kilometers away when Chen Changan and Chen Changan were talking.
"Subordinate, please see the Pavilion Master!"
Wang Tianji had returned to his original appearance, looking at the Tianji Pavilion members in front of him, and nodded calmly.
"After you return, you must pay close attention to Chen Yunxuan's every move."
"Although this person has just emerged, his achievements in the future are limitless."
"The more we know about him, the better it is for us, remember?"
"Yes, Pavilion Master."
"What about Chen Changan?"
Chen Changan?
Wang Tianji frowned slightly, feeling a little unsure for a moment.
